text: {"label":"Joint, Antecedent, and Contextual Control","definition":"Conceptual and applied work on control of behavior by multiple or contextual antecedents, especially joint control, intraverbal and contextual-function control, and control-system accounts such as feedback loops.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on joint control and conceptual analyses of control types, not general stimulus control research, self-control and impulsive choice, or conditioned reinforcement and stimulus-function pairing."}
